notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
This is a pretty big update hence the '1.1.0' version number. This will be the final 'level-tweaking' for a while to prevent unwanted confusion among players. A few levels have been switched around, so there will be a slight discrepancy with the save file. I apologize for not providing the best experience for early players.

Most of the 'multi-player' levels in The Village have been replaced by 'more interesting' puzzles. I've also reworked many parts of Springland to ramp up the difficulty. Here are the changes:

Improvements:
- lvl 3, 4, 6, 10 in Springland

New puzzles:
- lvl 1, 2, 3, 4 in The Village
- lvl 2, 14 in Springland

Replaced by existing levels (same puzzle, now in different level/world):
- lvl 6 in Death Valley
- lvl 10, 12 in The Village
- lvl 11 in Springland

One of my main goals was to make the mid-section more involving/challenging, hence 'The Village' (again) going through the most changes. Some levels in Springland has gone through almost imperceptible changes but that 'one block' sometimes makes all the difference. I hope the update will provide a better experience overall. The walkthrough playlist has also been updated.

Also I'd like to thank Lord Victor at Puzzle Lovers curator for his early feedback and support.

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
- Two levels have been removed from The Village. I wrote down the specific changes below. Main purpose was to improve the overall flow and quality of puzzles. I apologize for the changes...
  - Level 14 is removed.
  - level 5 is replaced by 13 (Auditorium). Thus there is no longer level 13.
  - level 4 is replaced by a new puzzle.
  - total number of puzzles is now 82 instead of 84

- Other updates:
  - Improved level 7 in Springland
  - Improved level 11 in Forbidden Temple
  - Improved level 3 in The Tower

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Fixed minor bug with Steam integration

Improved level 3 (Waterbottle) in Springland to prevent unintended solution.

Improved level 7 (Locksmithing) in The Tower to slightly ramp up difficulty.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Now includes native controller support
For Xbox controllers:
- directions: D-pad
- undo: B
- restart: Y
- escape: Start / Xbox Menu
- enter: A
- zoom: X
- mute: R/RS

Zoom button for keyboard is now 'X' instead of 'Y'

Confirm button is now either ENTER or SPACE
